profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary: MVS, COBOL, IDMS, JCL, Xpediter, TCP/IP, XML, VSAM, IBM DB2, FileAid, Requirements Analysis, IBM Mainframe

positions.title: Tax Preparer
positions.description: Prepared taxes for walk-in clients at a storefront Tax Preparation Office.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Development and maintenance of web content processes from both MVS Mainframe (IDMS) and Unix server (Oracle SQL) environments to a variety of platforms in various formats; development and maintenance of tcp/ip socket interfaces for ad entry, credit card authorization processing, and other functions, development, troubleshooting, and maintenance on large CICS application, development and maintenance of batch processes on MVS and Unix systems.

positions.title: Classified Department
positions.description: Sold classified ads via phone; performed editing duties on others’ work for publication; liaison between classified department and IT on classified automation project.

positions.title: RAOC Spec
positions.description: Received training in unit mission. Washed a lot of dishes and performed motor pool cleanup duties.

positions.title: Artillery crewman
positions.description: All responsibilities of the crewman including maintenance, repair (field and motor pool), daily/weekly/monthly services, combat readiness for tracked 8-inch howitzer and ammo transport vehicle.
